Class JournalService

java.lang.Object
lms.application.JournalService
public class JournalService extends Object
Application service for coordinating journal management use cases.

This service acts as an orchestrator between the user-facing layer and the domain/persistence layers. It is responsible for:

  • Enforcing authorization rules (e.g., only admins can add journals).
  • Delegating journal creation to the Journal domain entity, which encapsulates its own validation rules.
  • Interacting with a JournalsRepository to persist or retrieve journals.

The service does not contain core validation logic. Domain-specific validation rules (e.g., valid title/author/copies) are enforced by the Journal entity.

This design ensures separation of concerns: services coordinate, entities validate, repositories persist.
